title: 2b - What happens to water when it is heated? - Lab
description:
You will be completing the pre-lab in class today Wednesday (11/18)  and  
working on the lab experiment in class on Thursday.

There will be a lab quiz next Monday so pay attention during the lab!

*Procedure**:*

As a group, write a DETAILED procedure! (3 points)

Think about this lab’s objective: What happens to water (H2O) when it is  
heated from ice to boiling.         What steps would be necessary to  
collect the data? 

o   */Equipment you would have available: /**/Hot plates, beakers, ring  
stands with ring clamp, temperature probes, stirring rods, and ice. How would  
you put all these items to use?/*

o   *You should be able to hand your procedure to non-science person, and  
they would be able to set up the equipment and conduct this lab experiment  
perfectly using your written instructions.** *

          One step of the procedure needs to be:*Fill a 250 mL beaker  
about 1/3 way with crushed ice.*

 

*End step*

 

Keep heating the water and collecting temperature data on the app until the  
water has boiled for at least 2 minutes. - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8654531491
